text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Closing ceremony, huh... Well, there were various things happening at that time too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
閉会式か……
ふむ、
あのときも色々あったな。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: That's right. It was a bunch of nonsense piled up. Things happening here, things happening there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっすね。
トンチキ案件てんこ盛りでしたね。
アレがあそこでコレしたり、
ソレがこっちでナンだったり。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: It's just a bunch of pronouns, your statements are unclear.
text_block_list.orig_text:
指示代名詞ばかりで
要点の定まらぬ陳述だな。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: It's like they're all just vague.

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: No, I'm trying to be considerate, you know. But you probably don't want to remember things like Chieru running away or Yuni-senpai's clay figure going berserk.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、一応気ィ遣ってんだけど。
あんま思い出したくないでしょ、
チエルが逃げ出したり
ユニ先輩の粘土像が暴れたりとかそんなん。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Did things like that really happen?
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなことありましたっけ？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: I have no memory of that at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はて、
とんと覚えておらぬが。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: I do remember Chloe-senpai being unexpectedly enthusiastic during the last live though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最後のライブで、
クロエ先輩が意外とノリノリだったことは覚えてますけど。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Chloe-kun was unexpectedly in high spirits. I remember Chloe-kun dancing elegantly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな。
クロエ君が意外と華麗なステップを踏んでいたことは覚えている。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: I wonder when you practiced that. It wasn't just some kind of ad-lib, right? It was more than that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アレいつ練習したんですかね。
なんとなくアドリブで、
ってレベルじゃなかったですよね。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this? Would there be a problem if I practiced some unclear moves in the middle of the night? Huh? You want a piece of me, huh? If you're up for it, then let's go, come on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
なんだ？
うちが夜中に用途不明のフリをコソ練してたら問題あんのか？
ああッ？　てめ、
やんのかコラ。
やんならやんぞ、
表出ろコラ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Well, regardless of everything, St. Theresa's Fes was fun, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやあ、
なんだかんだ言っても楽しかったですよね、
テレフェス。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Don't ignore me. If you want to go, then go. If you want to challenge me, then bring it on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シカトしてんじゃねえぞコラ。
やんならやんぞ、
かかってこいコラ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Let's have another cheerful fest next year with everyone! The Friendship Club is forever invincible!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また来年も
みんなでちぇるっとフェスりましょう！
なかよし部は永遠に不滅です！

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: That's right. The Yuni-chan's will be forever invincible--
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな。
ユニちゃんズは永遠に不滅──

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text:
──Wait a second.
Hold on. Won't I have graduated by next year?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あれ？
ちょっと待って。
来年ぼく卒業してない？
